carGeometry.provenance: Calibrated native procedural sedan shell for this proof: body, cabin roof and wheels generated from these same explicit bounds. Not inferred from a flat sprite.

practice.title: MELEE / CARRY
practice.hint: J punch · K kick · G grab/release · T throw. The defender counters at close range.

car.title: MOVING SUPPORT
car.hint: On the teal launch block: time Space + W onto the approaching sedan. Release W before touchdown; Space + S jumps back off.

barrier.title: THROW / BREACH
barrier.hint: G grabs the guard; T throws him into the amber barricade. Then walk through the real opening.

drop.title: DROP / LANDING
drop.hint: G then T sends the guard over the bridge rail. You can also jump; hard landings injure either actor.

inspection.title: ACTOR INSPECTION
inspection.hint: Same bodies, source-scale art. V changes the other skin. Q swaps control. Tab exposes physical bounds.
